policy: An exact Latin word anchor is not an observation that the priest performed an action.
Never convert server bells or replies into a priest gesture or faithful posture.
Never present a fraction icon at narrative fregit.
Hanc igitur is not the temporal trigger for the anticipatory bell.
Major elevations and Per ipsum minor elevation must use distinct artwork.
The degree of the Supplices te rogamus bow is not certified by IX.1 itself.
Conditional Solemn deacon handling and celebrant genuflection require separate stages.
Icon suggestions are editorial only; no release or user-visible rendering follows.
A continuing hand/finger position and a held chalice need no flashing pictogram; avoid inventing new art for a state.
Only existing source stage IDs can receive atomic artwork references, and no suggested stage is activated by scrolling.
Short and long bilingual drafts remain an entirely separate editorial approval contract.
